variants.title: Mending nets
variants.premise: The fisher sits on the dock with a torn net across his knees, working a needle through it.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Could you take me out on your boat?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't talk to me outerlander. I'm mending this net.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: It's a simple question.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: And that's a simple answer. No.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He pulls the twine tight without looking up.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nobody who'd risk it on you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Go and ask them yourself.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Shark went straight through it.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: A big one?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Big enough. It had the catch as well.

options.label: You're a long way from Rellekka.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Aye. And it's far too hot here for a proper beard.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The fish don't mind. I do.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Good.

variants.title: Gutting sharks
variants.premise: The fisher is gutting a shark on a barrel by the water while gulls scream overhead.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I'm after passage out of Varlamore. Any boats?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Out where? There's nothing out there but water and weather.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Anywhere. I want to leave the kingdom.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then you want the capital, not me. I fish.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He flicks the guts into the sea. The gulls dive for them.

options.label: Have you been to the capital?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Never. It's too far from the water for me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nothing up there but people.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Wind's turning. There'll be swell by evening.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Bad for fishing?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Bad for outerlanders in small boats.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: This one's promised. It's on the ovens tonight.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Buy it there like everyone else.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Aye. Mind the gulls.

variants.title: The quiver
variants.premise: The fisher is hauling a crate of shark up the dock when the player stops him.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I need a boat out of the kingdom.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The fisher sets the crate down and looks you over.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That thing on your back. You fought for it?

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: In the Colosseum, yes.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Hah. Then you're not soft after all, outerlander.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Take it to the harbour in the capital. They keep a list there.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Some clerk with a ledger. Registrar, they call him.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Never met him. Sounds miserable.

options.label: Could you sail me out yourself?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: My boat's for fish, not passengers.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Not even for coin?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not even for coin. She stinks of shark.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: North of here. Civitas illa Fortis.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I've never seen it. Never wanted to.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Too many people, they tell me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Fair winds. You've earned that much.
